title: Camp Riverbend: Key Strengths and Highlights for Parents
summary: This report summarizes the key strengths and highlights of Camp Riverbend, focusing on quality and program accessibility, to aid parents in making informed decisions about their child's summer enrichment activities.

sections.title: Camp Riverbend: Strengths and Highlights
sections.content:
* **Legacy and Tradition:** Camp Riverbend boasts over 60 years of experience, run by multiple generations of the Breene family [1].
* **ACA Accreditation:** Accredited by the American Camp Association (ACA) since its first season, ensuring adherence to high safety and operational standards [1].
* **Diverse Programs:** Offers age-specific programs like Clubhouse (ages 3-5), Riverbend Experience (grades 1-8), and Day Trippers (grades 7-9) [1].
* **Nut-Free Environment:** Provides daily lunch and snacks, with all items being tree nut and peanut-free; gluten-free options are also available [1].
* **Transportation & Extended Day:** Includes bus transportation or extended day program (8:00 AM-6:00 PM) in tuition, offering flexibility for families [1].
